day.reading: an average divergence rate with no LTEE input is the speed any mechanism must have run at
day.holds: the arithmetic reproduces: 63.281 exactly, 1,958.81 from an unrounded mean of 62.682 and the inferred factor 25/0.80; no input is from the LTEE (evo006@L40)

critic.reading: a required fixation rate needs more steps than divergence / time
critic.holds: the numerator is both lineages (Day's own per-lineage figure halves the rate to 31.64 bp/y) and counts base pairs (about 9.5 bp per event on GAP-07b's count); constant rate, fixed rather than polymorphic sites and lineage assignment are not addressed in the post

notes: Every printed number reproduces. The 0.565 bp gap is the rounding of the six-ape mean: 1,958.81 implies a mean of 62.682 bp/y, which prints as 62.7. The factor 25/0.80 is inferred by the source map; it is the only round factor that fits. 'Rate of post-CHLCA human evolution' (L33) is read on a numerator that Day himself describes as the total over both lineages from the human perspective; on his per-lineage 199,336,636 the rate is 31.64 bp/y. Which reading the post intends is not stated; both are recorded. The six individual rates, the 60.5 My and the 25,302,032,866 bp are not held and not checked.
